description: This file defines the Response class, which extends the Message class and represents an HTTP response within the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It includes methods for constructing responses, marshalling, unmarshalling, and accessing the status code.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response message with a status code, extending the Message base class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Response object with HTTP method, path, query, headers, and status code.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes the Response object for transmission.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes data buffer into a Response object.

methods.name: status_code
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.
